Why bother

That smell coming from the garage isn’t going away on its own.

Every collection leaves a film of bacteria, mold, and rotting residue baked onto the inside of your bin by the sun. A hose and dish soap doesn’t touch it — and most municipalities don’t allow you to dump that dirty runoff down the storm drain anyway. We built a rig to solve exactly this problem.

01

Odor & pest control

Maggots, flies, and raccoons are all chasing the same residue. Regular cleaning removes the food source, not just the smell.

02

Actually eco-friendly

Our tank captures every drop of wastewater and disposes of it to code — nothing goes into your lawn, the street, or the sewer.

03

Zero effort for you

We show up the day after your regular pickup, clean curbside while your bin is empty, and you never have to touch it.

How it works

Three steps. Fifteen minutes. Curbside.

01

You book online

Pick one-time, monthly, or quarterly. Tell us how many bins and we’ll confirm your route day.

02

We meet your bin at the curb

Leave it out after collection. Our truck-mounted hopper blasts every wall with 200°F pressurized water.

03

It goes back spotless

Sanitized, deodorized, and rolled back into place. You’ll get a text when it’s done.

Service area

Based in Hilton. Rolling through every corner of Monroe County.

If your garbage truck can reach your curb, our rig can too. Ask about routes if you’re just outside these areas — we’re adding new streets every month. We also handle driveway, siding, and deck pressure washing & soft washing on the same visit if you need it.
